status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% more than the week before, most of them in Juba, Rumbek and Akobo.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Juba, Rumbek og Akobo.

summary.en: Violence persists with a grenade explosion killing four children and injuring two in Northern Bahr el Ghazal and clashes between Warrap and Lakes communities killing 14 people. The government dispatched 25 young professionals to Brazil for specialized farming training and President Salva Kiir traveled to Ethiopia, while Juba prepares to receive the Karuma hydropower plant by late 2026. UNHCR and South Sudan held talks to improve refugee support in Egypt, and authorities sentenced four individuals to 14 years for a sexual assault case in Sherikat. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Vold vedvarer med en granateksplosjon som drepte fire barn og såret to i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal, og sammenstøt mellom Warrap‑ og Lakes-samfunn som drepte 14 personer. Regjeringen sendte 25 unge fagfolk til Brasil for spesialisert jordbrukstrening, og president Salva Kiir reiste til Etiopia, mens Juba forbereder mottak av Karuma vannkraftverk innen slutten av 2026. UNHCR og Sør-Sudan holdt samtaler om bedre flyktningestøtte i Egypt, og myndighetene dømte fire personer til 14 år for en seksuell overgrepssak i Sherikat. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: South Sudanese Civil War
background.extract: The South Sudanese Civil War was a multi-sided civil war in South Sudan fought from 2013 to 2018 between government and opposition forces. The civil war caused rampant human rights abuses, including forced displacement, ethnic massacres, and killings of journalists by various parties. Since the war's end, South Sudan has been governed by a coalition formed by leaders of the former warring factions, Salva Kiir and Riek Machar. The country continues to recover from the war while experiencing ongoing and systemic ethnic violence.
